name: pipeline

# 持续运行的单一流水线：一轮跑完立刻 dispatch 下一轮，不再等整点 cron。
#
#   gate（判断是否需要探测/是否允许接续）
#     └→ probe(4 分片)  ← 仅当国内数据超过 55 分钟才跑（Globalping 额度按 IP 算，别打爆）
#          └→ merge-probe
#               └→ aggregate（TCP → TLS → WS 路径 → 国内剔除 → 排序 → 发布）
#                    └→ speedtest（并发 8）→ rerank（同轮生效）→ report
#                         └→ chain（dispatch 下一轮）
#
# 限流：最近 60 分钟内的运行数 >= 6 就不再接续，靠 10 分钟 cron 兜底。
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "*/10 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      budget:
        description: "每个探测分片的目标数"
        default: "120"
      force_probe:
        description: "强制跑国内探测（忽略新鲜度）"
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: node-radar-pipeline
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096

jobs:
  # ---------- ⓪ 决策：要不要探测、能不能接续 ----------
  gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      need_probe: ${{ steps.g.outputs.need_probe }}
      allow_chain: ${{ steps.g.outputs.allow_chain }}
      probe_age: ${{ steps.g.outputs.probe_age }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: g
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            let age = 9999;
            try {
              const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('dist/cn-probe.json', 'utf8'));
              age = (Date.now() - Date.parse(j.generatedAt)) / 60000;
            } catch {}
            const force = '${{ inputs.force_probe }}' === 'true';
            const need = force || age >= 55;
            core.info(`国内数据 ${age === 9999 ? '缺失' : age.toFixed(0) + ' 分钟前'} → ${need ? '本轮探测' : '跳过探测'}`);

            // 最近 60 分钟跑了多少轮（含当前这轮），超过 6 轮就不再接续
            const runs = await github.rest.actions.listWorkflowRuns({
              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo, workflow_id: 'pipeline.yml', per_page: 20,
            });
            const 近一小时 = runs.data.workflow_runs.filter(r => Date.now() - Date.parse(r.created_at) < 3600e3).length;
            const allow = 近一小时 < 6;
            core.info(`最近 60 分钟已运行 ${近一小时} 轮 → ${allow ? '允许接续' : '达上限，本轮不接续'}`);

            core.setOutput('need_probe', String(need));
            core.setOutput('allow_chain', String(allow));
            core.setOutput('probe_age', String(Math.round(age)));

  # ---------- ① 国内可达性探测（4 分片并行，各自独立 IP 额度）----------
  probe:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.need_probe == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Probe shard ${{ matrix.shard }}
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 35
        run: |
          node scripts/cn-probe-gp.mjs \
            --resume --shard=${{ matrix.shard }} --shards=8 \
            --budget=${{ inputs.budget || '120' }} --probes=2 --concurrency=8 --max-age-hours=36 \
            --out=dist/cn-probe-${{ matrix.shard }}.json
      - name: Upload shard
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cn-probe-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: dist/cn-probe-${{ matrix.shard }}.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 2

  # ---------- ② 合并分片 ----------
  merge-probe:
    needs: [gate, probe]
    if: always() && needs.gate.outputs.need_probe == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: cn-probe-shard-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Merge shards
        run: node scripts/merge-probes.mjs
      - name: Commit probe results
        run: |
          set -e
          [ -f dist/cn-probe.json ] || { echo "没有探测结果"; exit 0; }
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          # 生成物绝不参与 git 文本合并：两个版本的节点列表自动合并会产生重复键，
          # mihomo 能容忍但 js-yaml 报 duplicated mapping key，后续 rerank 直接崩。
          # 做法：备份我们的产物 → 硬重置到远端 → 还原 → 提交。
          mkdir -p /tmp/keep
          for f in dist/cn-probe.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && cp "$f" "/tmp/keep/$(basename $f)"; done
          git fetch origin ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}
          git reset --hard origin/${GITHUB_REF_NAME}
          for f in dist/cn-probe.json; do [ -f "/tmp/keep/$(basename $f)" ] && cp "/tmp/keep/$(basename $f)" "$f"; done
          for f in dist/cn-probe.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && git add -f "$f"; done
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore(probe): 国内可达性结果"
          git push origin HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME} || echo "推送失败，产物下轮重新生成"

  # ---------- ③ 聚合发布 ----------
  aggregate:
    needs: [gate, merge-probe]
    if: always() && (needs.merge-probe.result == 'success' || needs.gate.outputs.need_probe != 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci

      # 源清单自动刷新：超过 24 小时没更新就跑一轮多渠道发现（每周二的独立任务仍在，这里做兜底+提速）
      # 失败不影响聚合（用旧源继续合并），只是这轮不加新源
      - name: Refresh sources (if stale >24h)
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          AGE=$(node -e "
            const fs=require('fs');
            try{
              const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('sources.auto.json','utf8'));
              const t=Math.max(0,...a.map(x=>Date.parse(x.verifiedAt||0)));
              console.log(Math.floor((Date.now()-t)/3600e3));
            }catch(e){console.log(999)}
          ")
          echo "源清单 ${AGE} 小时前更新"
          if [ "$AGE" -lt 24 ]; then echo "未超过 24h，跳过刷新"; exit 0; fi
          node scripts/discovery/engine.mjs --budget=60 || echo "发现引擎失败，用现有源继续"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          for f in sources.auto.json sources.candidates.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && git add -f "$f"; done
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore(sources): 自动刷新公开源清单"
          git push origin HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME} || echo "源清单推送失败，下轮再试"

      - name: Aggregate
        run: node scripts/aggregate.mjs

      - name: Install mihomo
        run: |
          set -e
          URL=$(curl -sSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/MetaCubeX/mihomo/releases/latest \
            | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);const a=(j.assets||[]).find(x=>/linux-amd64-compatible/.test(x.name)&&/\.gz$/.test(x.name));console.log(a?a.browser_download_url:'')})")
          curl -sSL -o mihomo.gz "$URL" && gunzip -f mihomo.gz && chmod +x mihomo

      - name: Validate
        run: |
          set -e
          ./mihomo -t -d . -f dist/clash.yaml && echo "clash.yaml OK"
          ./mihomo -t -d . -f dist/clash-lite.yaml && echo "clash-lite.yaml OK"

      - name: Publish
        run: |
          set -e
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          # 生成物绝不参与 git 文本合并（会产生重复键 → js-yaml duplicated mapping key）
          mkdir -p /tmp/keep
          for f in dist/clash.yaml dist/clash-lite.yaml dist/summary.json sources.health.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && cp "$f" "/tmp/keep/$(basename $f)"; done
          # 新鲜度守卫：并发/排队时可能有一个更早启动的运行更晚提交，会把新产物覆盖成旧的
          # （实测：141 个的精简池被一个旧运行的 410 个覆盖）→ 只允许「更新」的产物写回
          OURS=$(node -e "try{console.log(Date.parse(require('./dist/summary.json').generatedAt))}catch(e){console.log(0)}")
          git fetch origin ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}
          THEIRS=$(git show origin/${GITHUB_REF_NAME}:dist/summary.json 2>/dev/null | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{try{console.log(Date.parse(JSON.parse(s).generatedAt))}catch(e){console.log(0)}})")
          if [ "$THEIRS" -gt "$OURS" ] 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "远端产物更新（$THEIRS > $OURS），放弃本次提交，保留远端版本"
            exit 0
          fi
          git reset --hard origin/${GITHUB_REF_NAME}
          for f in dist/clash.yaml dist/clash-lite.yaml dist/summary.json sources.health.json; do [ -f "/tmp/keep/$(basename $f)" ] && cp "/tmp/keep/$(basename $f)" "$f"; done
          for f in dist/clash.yaml dist/clash-lite.yaml dist/summary.json sources.health.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && git add -f "$f"; done
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore(aggregate): 更新公共节点池"
          git push origin HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME} || echo "推送失败，产物下轮重新生成"

      - name: Smoke test
        run: |
          # raw.githubusercontent 有 CDN 缓存，刚推完可能取到旧版本（旧版本可能含已修的畸形节点）
          # 所以带 cache-buster 重试几次，只有连续失败才判真失败
          for i in 1 2 3 4; do
            if curl -fsSL -m 60 -o published.yaml "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jingjiangze/node-radar/main/dist/clash.yaml?cb=$(date +%s)-$i"; then
              if ./mihomo -t -d . -f published.yaml; then
                echo "published OK ($(wc -c < published.yaml) bytes)"
                exit 0
              fi
              echo "第 $i 次校验失败（可能是 CDN 旧缓存），重试…"
            else
              echo "第 $i 次下载失败，重试…"
            fi
            sleep 15
          done
          echo "发布文件连续 4 次校验失败"
          exit 1

  # ---------- ④ 测速 + 同轮重排 ----------
  speedtest:
    needs: aggregate
    if: always() && needs.aggregate.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci

      - name: Install mihomo
        run: |
          set -e
          URL=$(curl -sSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/MetaCubeX/mihomo/releases/latest \
            | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);const a=(j.assets||[]).find(x=>/linux-amd64-compatible/.test(x.name)&&/\.gz$/.test(x.name));console.log(a?a.browser_download_url:'')})")
          curl -sSL -o mihomo.gz "$URL" && gunzip -f mihomo.gz && chmod +x mihomo

      - name: Speed test
        env:
          MIHOMO_BIN: ./mihomo
          SAMPLE: 60
          SPEED_CONCURRENCY: 8
        run: node scripts/speedtest.mjs

      # 注意：这里只提交 speed.json / speed-top.yaml。
      # clash.yaml / clash-lite.yaml 归 aggregate 所有——测速 job 检出的是它启动那一刻的版本，
      # 重排后提交会把 aggregate 刚发布的更新内容覆盖回旧的（实测 134 个被盖回 410 个）。
      # 速度数据由「下一次 aggregate」读取并参与排序，不再就地重排。
      - name: Commit speed results
        run: |
          set -e
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          mkdir -p /tmp/keep
          for f in dist/speed.json dist/speed-top.yaml; do [ -f "$f" ] && cp "$f" "/tmp/keep/$(basename $f)"; done
          git fetch origin ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}
          git reset --hard origin/${GITHUB_REF_NAME}
          for f in dist/speed.json dist/speed-top.yaml; do [ -f "/tmp/keep/$(basename $f)" ] && cp "/tmp/keep/$(basename $f)" "$f"; done
          for f in dist/speed.json dist/speed-top.yaml; do [ -f "$f" ] && git add -f "$f"; done
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore(speed): 更新实测速度"
          git push origin HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME} || echo "推送失败，下轮重新生成"

  # ---------- ⑤ 接续下一轮（持续运行的核心）----------
  # 只在「没有任何其他运行在排队/执行」时才派下一轮：
  #   · 没有守卫时，自链式接续会和 cron 叠加 → 多个运行重叠 → 旧代码的运行更晚提交，把新产物覆盖成旧的
  #   · 有守卫时，既保证不断档（cron 没触发时靠它驱动），又不会重叠
  chain:
    needs: [aggregate]
    if: always() && needs.aggregate.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const runs = await github.rest.actions.listWorkflowRuns({
              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
              workflow_id: 'pipeline.yml', per_page: 20,
            });
            const 活跃 = runs.data.workflow_runs.filter(
              (r) => ['queued', 'in_progress'].includes(r.status) && r.id !== context.runId
            );
            if (活跃.length) {
              core.info(`已有 ${活跃.length} 个运行在排队/执行（${活跃.map(r => r.id).join(',')}），跳过接续，避免重叠`);
              return;
            }
            core.info('没有其他运行，dispatch 下一轮以保持连续');
            await github.rest.actions.createWorkflowDispatch({
              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
              workflow_id: 'pipeline.yml', ref: 'main', inputs: { budget: '110' },
            });


  # ---------- ⑥ 汇总 ----------
  report:
    needs: [gate, merge-probe, aggregate, speedtest]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Summarize
        run: |
          {
            echo "## 本轮流水线"
            echo ""
            echo "| 阶段 | 结果 |"
            echo "|---|---|"
            echo "| 国内探测 | ${{ needs.gate.outputs.need_probe == 'true' && needs.merge-probe.result || '跳过（数据新鲜）' }} |"
            echo "| 聚合发布 | ${{ needs.aggregate.result }} |"
            echo "| 测速 | ${{ needs.speedtest.result }} |"
            echo ""
            node -e "
              const fs=require('fs');
              const r=(f)=>{try{return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))}catch{return null}};
              const cn=r('dist/cn-probe.json'), sp=r('dist/speed.json'), su=r('dist/summary.json');
              if(su) console.log('- 聚合：'+su.totalAlive+' 节点存活，'+Object.keys(su.regions||{}).length+' 个地区组');
              if(cn) console.log('- 国内：覆盖 '+(cn.total||0)+' 个 host:port，可达 '+(cn.ok||0)+'（'+cn.okRate+'%）');
              if(sp) console.log('- 测速：'+sp.ok+'/'+sp.sample+' 可用，中位 '+sp.medianMbps+' MB/s');
            "
          } >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

  notify:
    needs: [aggregate]
    if: failure()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const title = '[auto] 流水线失败';
            const body = [
              '本轮流水线失败，线上订阅保持上一版未覆盖。',
              '',
              `- 运行：${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`,
            ].join('\n');
            const issues = await github.rest.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo, state: 'open', labels: 'pipeline',
            });
            const exist = issues.data.find(i => i.title === title);
            if (exist) {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({ owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo, issue_number: exist.number, body });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.create({ owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo, title, labels: ['pipeline'], body });
            }
